title: Schedule of Charges for Giving Up, Missing or Changing a Car Rental
content:
This schedule carries, for the six Car Rental Rate Classes, the free-cancellation term, the flat charge and
the ladder a class publishes for a rental given up, the charge where the vehicle is never collected, and the
terms on which the rental may be changed.

## Free-cancellation term and flat charge

The free-cancellation term is a number of whole elapsed hours running from the moment the supplier confirmed
the renter's booking.

| Rate class | Free-cancellation term, in whole elapsed hours from confirmation | Flat charge for a rental given up, in USD | Charge where the vehicle is never collected, in USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 0 | 60 | 95 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 24 | 50 | 75 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 48 | 35 | 55 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 48 | 0 | 0 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 24 | 0 | 45 |

## Published ladder, as a share of the rental total

The ladder is keyed by how many whole days lie between the cancellation and the scheduled collection.

| Rate class | Fourteen or more days before collection | Thirteen to three days before collection | Two to one days before collection | On the day of collection |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 25 | 50 | 75 | 100 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 0 | 0 | 25 | 50 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 25 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 20 |

Every figure in the ladder is a percentage of the rental total. The Pay Now Saver Rate publishes 100 per
cent in all four bands and the Premium Inclusive Rate publishes nothing in all four.

## Changing a rental

| Rate class | Charge to move the collection or return time or branch, in USD | Greatest number of changes permitted on one rental |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 0 | 0 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 25 | 1 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 15 | 3 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 0 | 5 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 0 | 5 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 0 | 5 |

A ceiling of no changes and a charge of nothing stand together on the Pay Now Saver Rate: the class permits
no change, so it publishes no price for one. The three classes with a ceiling of five changes make no charge
for any of them.
